messages:
Clara: Quick flag — AtlasBiotech's on-prem renewal invoice INV-92345 exported with platform fee split into a 72k and 48k line. AR rejects because contract shows single 120k platform fee. Can billing ops help? :thinking_face:
Mason: Can you paste the export lines? Is this the renewal true-up or a midterm adjustment?
Clara: Renewal true-up. Export snippet: 
- PLATFORM_YEARLY 72,000.00 (GL 5010)
- PLATFORM_PRORATION 48,000.00 (GL 5111)
Contract AMND-2023-08 specifies one line: Platform Fee 120,000.
Ivy: Looks like the proration pipeline emitted a separate line for the mid-cycle seat increase. We should consolidate for customer AP. Two remediations: journal reclass or credit+reissue. Customer wants minimal docs.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-92345 created by billing-worker at 2065432095. Status: Pending.
Mason: Customer-facing path = credit memo + reissue. Ops path = journal. I vote credit+reissue to keep vendor view clean. Need approval and PR for GL move.
Rafael: Approving credit+reissue. Please reference amendment AMND-2023-08 in the memo and include PR-7450 for audit.
Ivy: Confirmed with AtlasBiotech on call — they prefer reissue and asked we preserve original invoice date in a memo. I'll draft talking points.
Clara: Created credit memo CM-599 at 2065432300 and drafted INV-92345-R1 with single platform fee 120,000. Memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2023-08. Ref: INV-92345"
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-599 created at 2065432300 by billing-worker.
Mason: PR-7450 posted at 2065432450 linking CM-599 and INV-92345-R1. Journal reclass GL 5111 -> 5010 completed.
Mason: INV-92345-R1 issued at 2065432500 and emailed to ap@atlasbiotech.example.
billing-bot: AR ingest processed at 2065432550. Status: Success.
Clara: Ran AR upload on our side too — succeeded. AtlasBiotech confirmed they matched on their AP side. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
Rafael: Filing short action item for eng-billing: prevent separate proration line emission when amendment flag present. Ticket FR-9333 created. :memo:
